Staff Software Engineer

Imaginary Labs is a fictional company building developer tools. This is a fully remote role open to candidates in the US. We are a team of 300 employees and raised $40M in funding.

What you'll do

  • Design services in TypeScript and Node.js used by thousands of teams every day.
  • Lead technical design reviews and mentor engineers across the organization.
  • Improve the performance of our React frontend and the APIs behind it.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $180,000 - $215,000 per year, plus equity and a 401k match.
